llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple strong scam characteristics: promises of guaranteed and unreasonably high returns (10% daily, $22,000 profit in weeks), fabricated and emotionally manipulative testimonials, urgency and appeals to psychological weakness (fast setup, happiness, life-changing income), mismatched or fake business details (USA address with a UK postal code, generic email and phone), excessive acceptance of payment methods but lack of standard financial protection, no actual regulatory or privacy details, and mimics the appearance and language of legitimate trading platforms. These factors collectively indicate a high-probability Cryptocurrency Scam/Investment Scam.
